# This robot rapper has 9m followers on TikTok (Music Business Worldwide)

By Murray Stassen. Apr 1, 2021.

## Key findings
- **FN Meka** (AI-powered robot rapper, 9M TikTok followers) was created by **Factory New**, a "'virtual' record label" / "next-generation music company, specializing in virtual beings."
- **Anthony Martini** is **co-founder of Factory New**; he is also (at the time) **CEO of Royalty Exchange** (online royalty-selling platform) and founder of Commission Records.
- Martini's partner at Factory New is **Brandon Le** (video-game 'skin' designer).
- FN Meka "is voiced by a human. But... everything else about him – from his lyrics to the chords and tempo – is based on AI."
- Factory New uses AI to make music, AR for TikTok content, and decentralized finance for digital goods; also launched crypto-rapper **Lil Bitcoin**.
- No funding/VC figure for Factory New is disclosed in this source.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — MBW, recognized domain authority.
- Establishes FN Meka's company = **Factory New**, creators **Anthony Martini (co-founder) + Brandon Le**, and that Martini is CEO of Royalty Exchange. Supports Q3 (company + CEO for the FN Meka avatar). No external VC disclosed for Factory New (relevant to Q2 negative).
